tagline.en: Watches for available image updates for the containers, applying nothing itself — it only reports
tagline.pt: Monitora as atualizações de imagem disponíveis pros containers, sem aplicar nada sozinho — só avisa

wud-admin-password.note: WUD 9 removed anonymous access and fails fast at startup with no administrator. The username is fixed in the unit; only the password is a secret.
